meta.author:
讚美之泉
詞：游智婷／曲：曾祥怡

lines.a: 主 我們同心在祢面前
lines.b: We come together in unity
To seek Your face as we pray
We turn away from our sinful ways
We're called to walk in Your ways

lines.a: 主 我們是屬祢的子民
lines.b: We are the people called by Your name
Give us Your heart as we pray

lines.a: 我們要回轉向祢 父神
lines.b: Send us revival, forgive our sins
Lord, let Your kingdom come

lines.a: 我們呼求祢 阿爸父
lines.b: We come together in unity
To seek Your face as we pray

lines.a: 祢必睜眼看 側耳垂聽
lines.b: We turn away from our sinful ways
We're called to walk in Your ways
Father this nation belongs to You
Pour out Your spirit, we pray

lines.a: 復興這地 全能的君王
lines.b: Send us Your mercy and heal our land
Lord let Your glory fall

lines.a: 主 我們同心在祢面前
lines.b: Oh Abba we cry out to You
Restore Your throne upon this land
Open Your eyes, and hear our cries
Forgive us Lord, we pray

lines.a: 主 我們國家是屬於祢
lines.b: All nations bow before Your throne
To lift Your name above all names

lines.a: 願祢來憐憫 醫治這地
lines.b: Come and reign, Almighty King
Meet us in this place

lines.a: 復興這地 全能的君王
lines.b: Send us Your mercy and heal our land
Lord let Your glory fall
